title: 楔子 圣天一脉第1章 玲珑惊诸天
content_zh:
楔子圣天一脉
启玄星，纪元之末！
圣心山脉！
整片天地雷光吞吐，宛如是雷龙在咆哮，发出低沉的狂暴雷鸣，那恐怖的雷鸣声，引得天地震荡。
无垠的群山之中，无边无际的天空上，云层翻滚，雄浑而苍茫，带出一片浓浓的远古神秘气息。
而此地，此刻却是有着无穷煞气遮蔽苍天！
整片天地如同乌云压顶，—片灰蒙，渗透着浓浓的怨念，煞气，隐有大道悲鸣之音若隐若现。
光秃秃的山脉，仿若死寂的世界，没有丝毫的生机，除了无尽凶煞之气，再无他物。
那种纯粹的漆黑如墨的凶煞之气，却隐隐的弥漫着一种血雨腥风，让得天地压抑，宛若堕落无边地狱！
“恐怕又是一场灭世之劫啊！”
目睹着这片天地的无穷凶煞之气，不少人怀着心悸的叹息不已。
这里，并不代表整个星界的天地，甚至可以说仅是一片山脉地带，但熟知一些古老秘辛的人都知道，这里孕育的，正是星界的灭世灾难。
而这种迹象，也并非今日如此，而是近代便一直这样，并且愈演愈烈！
而这里，同样孕育着一丝星界的生机，一丝关乎星界未来的命运。
无数人汇聚而来，正是苦苦等待着这一丝星界未来的生机出现。
轰隆隆！
突然，一阵震耳欲聋的轰鸣之音自远处天地相接之处滚滚而来。
巨大声音响彻天地，随着此雷鸣之音，一点光耀突然出现在这无尽灰蒙世界之中，这光耀陡然间放射出耀眼的青光，当这点亮光无比强烈之时。
轰隆！
在青光闪耀之处，无穷粘稠如液的凶煞之气奔腾翻滚，席卷向前，不过瞬息之间，已如沸腾的热水，千丈巨浪直冲天际！

嘭！
一阵猛烈的爆炸风暴中，有着一股邪恶的意志力量不断入侵，顿时耀眼的青光被这无穷凶煞之气淹没。
噗！
噗！
噗！
又是数道闷响！
无数的血水在粘稠如液的凶煞之气中汩汩流淌，很快汇聚成了血红色的河流，血红色的河流中，有无尽亡灵哀嚎，数以亿万计的骷髅白骨在若隐若现，显得诡异之极。
血光冲天而起，将这暗沉的天空映红。
嗤嗤嗤！
那种血光，仿佛有着一种无比邪恶的侵蚀力，即便是那神圣的青色光华，也是在这血光侵蚀之下一点点的磨灭，直到消失。
此时，天地只余一片血红！
在将神圣青光压制之后，那无尽凶煞之气瞬间就变得汹涌澎湃起来，无数的骷髅白骨在血红色的河流中肆掠，无边无际的凶煞之气变得嚣张起来。
周围无数人眼中突然露出了惶恐的神情！
而此时，一外表看约三十的男子盘坐在一座小山上，双目微闭，却是平静如幽潭，那般淡定从容的姿态，倒是让得不少人感到愧然。
盘坐在小山上的男子名叫肖纳，乃受师尊传命前来此地。
本来，肖纳是要和妻子一同前来的，但是妻子怀孕已经有三年零六个月了，而就在这个时候，腹中胎儿作动，似有降生出世迹象。
content_en:
wedge holy heaven lineage
Qixuan Star, the end of the era!
Sacred Heart Mountains!
The whole sky and earth were filled with thunder and lightning, like a thunder dragon roaring, emitting low and violent thunder. The terrifying thunder caused the heaven and earth to tremble.
Among the boundless mountains and in the boundless sky, the clouds are rolling, majestic and vast, giving off a strong ancient mysterious atmosphere.
But here, at this moment, there is endless evil energy covering the sky!
The whole sky and earth were like dark clouds, a gray mist, permeated with thick resentment and evil spirits, and the faint sound of the mournful sound of the avenue could be heard.
The bare mountains are like a dead world, without any vitality, and there is nothing but endless evil energy.
That kind of pure black and evil aura is faintly filled with a bloody wind, making the world oppressive, like falling into endless hell!
"I'm afraid it's another world-destroying disaster!"
Witnessing the infinite evil aura in this world, many people sighed with palpitations.
This place does not represent the entire world of the Star Boundary. It can even be said to be just a mountain range. However, those who are familiar with some ancient secrets know that what is gestating here is the disaster of the Star Boundary's destruction.
And this sign is not the same today, but has been like this in modern times, and it is getting worse!
And here, there is also a trace of the vitality of the star realm, a trace of the future destiny of the star realm.
Countless people gathered here, waiting hard for this glimmer of hope for the future of the star realm to appear.
Boom!
Suddenly, a deafening roar came from where the sky and the earth met in the distance.
A huge sound resounded throughout the world, and with the sound of thunder, a little light suddenly appeared in this endless gray world. This light suddenly emitted a dazzling green light. When this light was extremely intense.
Boom!
Wherever the green light shines, the infinitely thick and liquid-like evil energy surges and rolls forward, but in an instant, it is like boiling hot water, and a huge wave of thousands of feet rises straight into the sky!
Bang!
In a violent explosion storm, an evil force of will continued to invade, and the dazzling blue light was suddenly overwhelmed by the infinite evil energy.
puff!
puff!
puff!
There were several muffled sounds again!
Countless amounts of blood flowed gurgling in the thick liquid-like ominous aura, and soon gathered into a blood-red river. In the blood-red river, there were endless howls of the undead, and billions of skeletons and bones were looming, which looked extremely weird.
Bloody light rose into the sky, making the dark sky red.
Tsk tsk tsk!
That kind of blood light seemed to have an extremely evil corrosive power. Even the sacred cyan brilliance was gradually eroded by the blood light until it disappeared.
At this time, there was only blood red left in the world!
After suppressing the sacred green light, the endless ferocious aura instantly became turbulent. Countless skeletons and bones were plundering in the blood-red river, and the boundless ferocious aura became arrogant.
Countless people around suddenly had a look of fear in their eyes!
At this time, a man who looked about thirty was sitting cross-legged on a hill with his eyes slightly closed, but he was as calm as a deep pool. His calm and calm attitude made many people feel ashamed.
The man sitting cross-legged on the hill is named Xiao Na, and he was ordered to come here by his master.
Originally, Xiaona was going to come with his wife, but his wife had been pregnant for three years and six months, and at this time, the fetus in her belly moved, as if there were signs of birth.
